c18.note: The auditor's report and management signatures are dated Feb 19, 2026, consistent with the 10-K filing date.

c19.note: The release says W.W. Grainger, Inc. reported 2025 revenue of $17.9 billion.

c20.note: The $17.9B is full-year 2025 reported sales (10-K: $17,942M), not a TTM figure or a forecast.

c21.note: The Q3 2026 release shows net sales of $5,181M, up 11.3% reported and 14.9% on a daily, organic constant currency basis.

c15.note: Grainger's Q3 2026 release (Nov 4, 2026) raised FY2026 net sales guidance to $19.8–$20.0B, up from $19.4–$19.7B. FY2026 is not over, so this figure is guidance, not reported revenue.
